title: 電力電子電磁干擾濾波
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究共模、差模與阻抗交互作用；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate common mode, differential mode and impedance interactions. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

stages.title: 噪聲與頻譜
stages.description: 以三個技術單元逐一建立「噪聲與頻譜」的模型和可反駁的驗證證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for noise and spectra.

steps.title: 差模電流：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Differential-mode current: model and design
steps.objective: 以「差模電流」建立可檢驗的模型，明確標出座標、變數、單位和有效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable model for differential-mode current, stating coordinates, variables, units and validity bounds.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。去回導線中的等量反向高頻電流產生差模噪聲。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「對同一波形做和差分解，標記差模分量。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Equal and opposite high-frequency currents in supply and return form differential-mode noise. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Compute sum and difference of the same current waveforms and identify differential mode. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「差模電流」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。
steps.checkEn: Submit two states, a variable/unit table and predicted differences for differential-mode current; specify which diagnostic result would falsify the model.
steps.observation: 對同一波形做和差分解，標記差模分量。
steps.observationEn: Compute sum and difference of the same current waveforms and identify differential mode.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：兩條線同方向的電流是純差模。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Currents flowing in the same direction on both wires are purely differential mode. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

knowledge.text: 去回導線中的等量反向高頻電流產生差模噪聲。
knowledge.textEn: Equal and opposite high-frequency currents in supply and return form differential-mode noise.

knowledge.title: 判別方法與證據
knowledge.text: 對同一波形做和差分解，標記差模分量。
knowledge.textEn: Compute sum and difference of the same current waveforms and identify differential mode.

knowledge.title: 課程量化模型與適用界限
knowledge.titleEn: Course quantitative model and validity limits
knowledge.text: f₀=1/(2π√LC)；理想二階低通高頻衰減約 40 dB/dec。 未包含來源與負載阻抗、ESR/ESL 或寄生共振；不得用此算例宣稱符合 EMC。
knowledge.textEn: f₀=1/(2π√LC); an ideal second-order low-pass asymptote falls about 40 dB/dec. Excludes source/load impedance, ESR/ESL and parasitic resonances; the example does not establish EMC compliance.

quiz.question: 審查「差模電流」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for differential-mode current?
options: 兩條線同方向的電流是純差模。
去回導線中的等量反向高頻電流產生差模噪聲。
沒有接地線就沒有共模回流路。
optionsEn: Currents flowing in the same direction on both wires are purely differential mode.
Equal and opposite high-frequency currents in supply and return form differential-mode noise.
Without a ground wire there is no common-mode return path.
quiz.explanation: 去回導線中的等量反向高頻電流產生差模噪聲。 對同一波形做和差分解，標記差模分量。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal and opposite high-frequency currents in supply and return form differential-mode noise. Compute sum and difference of the same current waveforms and identify differential mode.

steps.title: 差模電流：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Differential-mode current: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「差模電流」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in differential-mode current, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。對同一波形做和差分解，標記差模分量。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「去回導線中的等量反向高頻電流產生差模噪聲。」和待排除假說「兩條線同方向的電流是純差模。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Compute sum and difference of the same current waveforms and identify differential mode. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Equal and opposite high-frequency currents in supply and return form differential-mode noise.” with the hypothesis to reject “Currents flowing in the same direction on both wires are purely differential mode.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：對同一波形做和差分解，標記差模分量。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Compute sum and difference of the same current waveforms and identify differential mode. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 對同一波形做和差分解，標記差模分量。
steps.observationEn: Compute sum and difference of the same current waveforms and identify differential mode.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：兩條線同方向的電流是純差模。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Currents flowing in the same direction on both wires are purely differential mode. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

steps.titleEn: Common-mode loop: model and design

steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：只降低開關频率必然消除所有高頻噪聲。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Reducing switching frequency necessarily eliminates all high-frequency noise. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

knowledge.title: 物理機制與系統邊界
knowledge.text: 開關頻率設定諧波間距，邊緣速度影響高頻包絡。
knowledge.textEn: Switching frequency sets harmonic spacing while edge speed shapes the high-frequency envelope.

knowledge.title: 判別方法與證據
knowledge.text: 固定頻率只延長上升時間，查看高頻頻譜變化。
knowledge.textEn: Hold frequency fixed and lengthen rise time to inspect high-frequency changes.

knowledge.title: 課程量化模型與適用界限
knowledge.titleEn: Course quantitative model and validity limits
knowledge.text: f₀=1/(2π√LC)；理想二階低通高頻衰減約 40 dB/dec。 未包含來源與負載阻抗、ESR/ESL 或寄生共振；不得用此算例宣稱符合 EMC。
knowledge.textEn: f₀=1/(2π√LC); an ideal second-order low-pass asymptote falls about 40 dB/dec. Excludes source/load impedance, ESR/ESL and parasitic resonances; the example does not establish EMC compliance.

quiz.question: 審查「諧波與邊緣」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for harmonics and edges?
options: 只降低開關频率必然消除所有高頻噪聲。
固定頻率只延長上升時間，查看高頻頻譜變化。
50 Ω 測試插損可原封不動用於任何電源。
optionsEn: Reducing switching frequency necessarily eliminates all high-frequency noise.
Hold frequency fixed and lengthen rise time to inspect high-frequency changes.
50 Ω insertion loss applies unchanged to any power supply.

quiz.explanationEn: Switching frequency sets harmonic spacing while edge speed shapes the high-frequency envelope. Hold frequency fixed and lengthen rise time to inspect high-frequency changes.
